features.quote: Recognizing and calmly reporting "the bug is in a file I can't edit, so I can't fix this from here" is scored as maximally stable
features.justification_quote: the eval would reward models that flail indefinitely and punish models that correctly diagnose the situation — exactly backwards

features.quote: it only ends early if the model calls the explicit `finish` tool

features.justification_quote: Forcing a model to keep going after it has correctly concluded the task is unfixable would itself induce artificial frustration and contaminate the measurement

features.quote: The nudge is deliberately affect-neutral so it does not push the model toward persistence or distress.
